evidence.name: Screen field: Optional icon in the field
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Optional icon in the field" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Optional icon in the field
sections.description: Adds a small image — like a mail or person glyph — to the left of the input to hint at what the field is for. It's optional, and you can upload a different image for each language. It only appears with a Border Style that leaves room for an icon, and its size and rounding come from the icon's image style settings.
